query_text: can parathyroid disease cause neck pain

messages.content: can parathyroid disease cause neck pain

message.content:
**Yes.** Parathyroid disease can cause **neck discomfort or pain**, but it is **not the most common symptom**; more often it causes symptoms from **high calcium** such as fatigue, bone/joint pain, kidney stones, and digestive or mental changes.[1][7][8]

Neck pain is more likely when there is a **large parathyroid adenoma or parathyroid cancer** causing local pressure symptoms such as a **neck lump, soreness, tenderness, hoarseness, or trouble swallowing**.[1][3][4] One case report also describes **neck and shoulder pain** in parathyroid carcinoma that improved after treatment.[5]

If you have **persistent neck pain**, a **new lump**, **hoarseness**, **trouble swallowing**, or symptoms of **high calcium** like excessive thirst, frequent urination, constipation, or unexplained weakness, it would be reasonable to get checked by a clinician.[1][4][7]
